name: Ahmad bin Hassan
bio:
Ahmad’s meticulous nature was evident early on, disassembling and reassembling his toys as a child just to understand how they worked. This curiosity led him to pursue a degree in Mechanical Engineering at Universiti Teknologi Malaysia, where he specialized in materials science. Motorsports caught his attention during his university years, captivated by the precision and innovation required to push vehicles to their absolute limits. After graduating, Ahmad landed a role at Proton, working in their quality assurance department, before eventually joining Opala Legends.

Ahmad's approach to quality control is proactive rather than reactive. He believes in identifying potential issues before they become problems, utilizing a combination of data analysis and hands-on inspection. His perfectionism is a strength, ensuring that every component meets the highest standards. However, he also recognizes the need for efficiency and strives to balance thoroughness with speed. His background in materials science provides him with a unique perspective, allowing him to evaluate the long-term durability and performance of components under extreme stress.

What distinguishes Ahmad is his unwavering dedication to excellence and his ability to work independently. While he values teamwork, he thrives when given the autonomy to pursue solutions on his own. This 'lone wolf' approach, coupled with his innate curiosity, makes him a valuable asset to the Opala Legends team. He is constantly seeking innovative ways to improve the quality control process and contribute to the team's overall success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: Ahmad is of average height with a wiry build, often seen with a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rapidly when deep in thought.
Insists on personally inspecting the welds on every chassis component.
